# Affinity by Serif

> Professional creative software suite (Photo, Designer, Publisher) with comprehensive learning resources, licensing guides, and cross-platform support for Mac, Windows, and iPad.

Affinity provides official documentation, tutorials, and support resources for its creative applications across multiple languages and platforms. The site emphasizes self-service learning, license activation, and software updates for both V1 and V2 versions of Affinity products.

## Key Topics

- Affinity Photo
- Affinity Designer
- Affinity Publisher
- License Activation
- Affinity Store
- Mac App Store
- iPad Apps
- Affinity V2
- Getting Started
- Tutorial
- Universal License
- Perpetual License
- Account Management
- Affinity ID
- Cross-Platform Support

## Support & Learning Hubs

- [Affinity Support & Learning | Help for Existing Users](https://affinity.serif.com/v2): Support hub with guides, tutorials, and updates for Affinity Photo, Designer, and Publisher.
- [Affinity Support & Learning | Help for Existing Users](https://affinity.serif.com/en-us/v2): Support hub with guides, tutorials, and updates for Affinity Photo, Designer, and Publisher.

## License Activation & Registration

- [How to install Affinity updates](https://affinity.serif.com/en-us/learn-v2/how-do-i-install-affinity-updates): Guide for installing free software updates across Mac, Windows, and iPad platforms.
- [Guida per la registrazione e attivazione di Affinity 2 (Affinity Store)](https://affinity.serif.com/it/learn-v2/in-app-licence-activation-affinity-store): Italian guide for registering and activating Affinity 2 apps from Affinity Store.
- [Anleitung zur Registrierung und Aktivierung von Affinity-Produkten der Version 2 (Affinity Store)](https://affinity.serif.com/de/learn-v2/in-app-licence-activation-affinity-store): German guide for registering and activating Affinity V2 products from Affinity Store.
- [Guide d'enregistrement et d'activation d'Affinity 2 (Mac App Store)](https://affinity.serif.com/fr/learn-v2/affinity-licensing-registration-and-activation-guide-mac-app-store): French guide for registering and activating Affinity 2 via Mac App Store.
- [Cómo activar y registrar licencias](https://affinity.serif.com/es/learn-v2/in-app-licence-activation): Spanish guide for activating and registering Affinity V2 licenses.
- [Guia de registro e ativação Affinity 2 (Mac App Store)](https://affinity.serif.com/pt-br/learn-v2/affinity-licensing-registration-and-activation-guide-mac-app-store): Portuguese guide for registering and activating Affinity 2 via Mac App Store.
- [Ativação de licença e registro explicados](https://affinity.serif.com/pt-br/learn-v2/in-app-licence-activation): Portuguese guide explaining license activation and registration process.

## Getting Started & Tutorials

- [Getting Started with Affinity Photo V2 | Learn Photo Editing](https://affinity.serif.com/en-us/learn-v2/tutorials/getting-started-with-affinity-photo): Beginner tutorial for Affinity Photo V2 with expert James Ritson.
- [Tutorial e risorse per Affinity Publisher su desktop](https://affinity.serif.com/it/learn-v2/publisher/desktop): Italian tutorials and guides for Affinity Publisher desktop publishing software.
- [Affinity Photo iPad – Official Learning Resources](https://affinity.serif.com/en-us/learn-v2/photo/ipad): Official learning resources and tutorials for Affinity Photo iPad app.
- [Affinity Publisher para iPad – Recursos oficiais de aprendizado](https://affinity.serif.com/pt-br/learn-v2/publisher/ipad): Portuguese learning resources for Affinity Publisher iPad app.
